baseline: B00: pure 250-observation new-high Long and new-low Short; compare momentum overlays against this breakout-only base

trials.description: Pure breakout base: new-high Long and new-low Short; momentum off on both sides
Add 50% res60s1 momentum only to active new-high Long breakouts; Short remains pure new-low breakout
Add 50% res60s1 momentum only to active new-low Short breakouts; Long remains pure new-high breakout
Add 50% res60s1 momentum to both active Long and Short breakout legs

feature_definitions.res60s1: centered cross-sectional rank in [-1,1] of preceding 60 observed residual-return rows per listing segment; excludes current row; min_periods=60
feature_definitions.corporate_action_scale: Within a listing segment, cumulative product of observed AdjustmentFactor event multipliers; divide raw High, Low, and Close by the scale before comparisons.
feature_definitions.prior_high_low: Rolling max of split-safe raw High and rolling min of split-safe raw Low over exactly the prior 250 observed rows, excluding signal-day High/Low; require 250 valid observations.
feature_definitions.long_breakout: active when Close_t > prior_high_250; within each date rank only active positive (Close_t/prior_high_250 - 1) excesses by percentile; score strength = 0.5 + 0.5*percentile, else 0.
feature_definitions.short_breakout: active when Close_t < prior_low_250; within each date rank only active positive (prior_low_250/Close_t - 1) excesses by percentile; signed score = -(0.5 + 0.5*percentile), else 0.
feature_definitions.momentum_overlay: For active side breakouts only, M10/M01/M11 replace that side score with sign-preserving clip of 0.5*breakout_score + 0.5*res60s1 to [0,+infinity) for Long or (-infinity,0] for Short. No breakout means score remains 0 even when momentum is on.
feature_definitions.smoothing: EWMA alpha=0.25, adjust=False per listing segment after score composition.
feature_definitions.portfolio: Existing official-compatible five-quintile score weights and one-way 10 bps cost, unchanged across all four variants.

model: Deterministic rule-based signed breakout score with independent Long/Short momentum overlays; no fitted parameters

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive comparison of exactly four pre-registered combinations; M10/M01/M11 compared against breakout-only B00. No adoption or reselection from known data.
